parameters.query:
=SELECT p.id, p.ip, p.ms
FROM site_proxy_stats s
JOIN proxy_lst p ON p.id = s.proxy_id
WHERE s.domain = '{{ $json.domain }}'
  AND p.status = 1
  AND p.ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ms <= 4000
  AND s.fail_count < 3
  AND (s.cooldown_until IS NULL OR s.cooldown_until <= NOW())
ORDER BY s.ok_count DESC, COALESCE(s.last_used_at, '1970-01-01') ASC, p.ms ASC
LIMIT 6

=SELECT p.id, p.ip, p.ms
FROM proxy_lst p
LEFT JOIN site_proxy_stats s ON s.proxy_id = p.id AND s.domain = '{{ $('Init').item.json.domain }}'
WHERE p.status = 1
  AND p.ms IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ms <= 4000
  AND s.proxy_id IS NULL
ORDER BY RAND()
LIMIT 8
